CLICK SURVEY - CONDITIONAL QUESTIONS UPDATE
Prepared 29 October 2026

This is the Click Survey application update, not a WordPress plugin.
The ZIP contains the current application source, including the existing email
settings work and the new conditional question feature. It contains no .env,
credentials, database records, test emails, backups or node_modules.

UPLOAD LOCATION
/home/clickeco/clicksurvey
Do not extract into public_html or a WordPress plugins directory.
The files are at the ZIP root: app.js, src/, views/, public/, etc.

1. Before uploading, take a database backup and a copy of the existing application
   files. Keep the existing production .env and node_modules directory in place.
   Existing test emails and survey responses do not need to be deleted.

2. Arrange a short maintenance window. Pause the web and worker watchdog cron
   entries and stop only the Click Survey web and worker processes. The private
   watchdog scripts are in /home/clickeco/.config/clicksurvey. Other applications
   share this hosting account; do not stop all Node processes or other cron jobs.
   If you cannot manage these processes, ask hosting support to perform steps
   2, 4 and 5 using these instructions.

3. In cPanel File Manager, upload the ZIP into /home/clickeco/clicksurvey and
   extract it there, overwriting the matching application files. Do not delete
   the folder first. Preserve .env, node_modules, backups, and private hosting
   configuration. No dependency changes are required for this update.

4. Apply the database migration BEFORE restarting the app. Choose ONE method:

   A. cPanel phpMyAdmin (manual upload option):
      Select the existing clickeco_clicksurvey database. Import the included
      MANUAL-MIGRATION.sql file. It is written for the documented live MariaDB
      server and the existing hardened Click Survey installation. It converts
      the three internal tables to InnoDB, adds four nullable columns and
      records migrations 002 and 003. It does not delete
      survey data. Stop and resolve any SQL error before proceeding.

   B. Terminal (standard application migration):
      cd /home/clickeco/clicksurvey
      Use the existing dedicated migration database account via DB_USER and
      DB_PASSWORD in the process environment, without replacing production .env.
      Run with the hosting account's low-thread settings:
      UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE=1 NODE_OPTIONS="--v8-pool-size=1 --max-old-space-size=256" /opt/alt/alt-nodejs22/root/usr/bin/node scripts/migrate.js
      Expect: Database migrations complete
      Restore the runtime environment before restarting services. The runtime
      database account does not have schema modification permissions.

5. Resume the original watchdog cron entries and invoke web-watchdog.sh and
   worker-watchdog.sh, or allow their next scheduled run. Keep using the existing
   loopback proxy configuration. Do NOT press Start in cPanel's Node selector;
   that is not how this installation is supervised.

6. Verify these URLs return HTTP 200 and the indicated status:
   https://clickecommerce.com.au/clicksurvey/health  -> ok
   https://clickecommerce.com.au/clicksurvey/ready   -> ready
   The worker heartbeat may take a minute to refresh.

7. Sign in and open a survey's Questions page. Add a Yes / No question first.
   Add or edit a follow-up. In Conditional question, select the earlier question
   and Yes. Add another follow-up with the same parent and No. Open the survey
   and check that changing Yes to No swaps the visible questions. Required
   hidden questions must not block submission. Test both a public survey link
   and an available test invitation if you use both methods.

USING CONDITIONAL QUESTIONS
- Always show preserves the existing behaviour.
- A condition can match an earlier Yes/No, choice, checkbox or rating answer.
- Add several questions with the same condition for a longer branch.
- Conditional questions can themselves control later questions.
- Hidden questions and their descendants are skipped; hidden answers are cleared.
- Update dependent conditions before archiving their parent or removing an option.
- Respondents need JavaScript enabled for conditional surveys.

AFTER UPDATING
Remove the uploaded ZIP from the server after successful extraction. Retain your
backup privately. If the update fails, keep services paused and restore the
previous application and database together from the pre-update backup.

The application was deployed to VentraIP on 29 October 2026. This revised package
includes the compatibility fix for legacy internal MyISAM tables. See the chat
for final verification results.
